economic_policy.taxation: Flat tax or consumption-based tax to replace income tax; eliminate capital gains and estate taxes; drastically reduce overall tax burden.
economic_policy.trade: Unilateral free trade; eliminate all tariffs and trade barriers; oppose government subsidies that distort markets.
economic_policy.regulation: Abolish most federal regulatory agencies; rely on private certification, tort law, and market competition to ensure quality and safety.

social_policy.healthcare: Fully deregulated healthcare market; eliminate insurance mandates; allow direct primary care and cross-border drug importation; end government healthcare programmes over time.
social_policy.education: Separate education from the state; full school choice with tax credits; oppose federal education mandates and standardised testing requirements.
social_policy.housing: Abolish zoning laws and building codes that restrict supply; eliminate government housing programmes; let the market set prices.
social_policy.civil_rights: Maximise personal freedom: full drug legalisation; marriage privatisation; protect free speech absolutely; oppose all forms of censorship.
social_policy.immigration: Open borders with security screening; eliminate immigration quotas; allow free movement of people and labour.

governance.decentralization: Radical federalism; return almost all functions to states or private sector; sunset all federal programmes not in the Constitution.
governance.transparency: Audit and end the Federal Reserve; publish all government activities; eliminate classified budgets except narrow national security.
governance.electoral_reform: Term limits; ballot access reform to end two-party duopoly; oppose public financing of campaigns as compelled speech.

environment.climate_action: Oppose carbon taxes and cap-and-trade; rely on property rights and tort law to address pollution; let market innovation drive clean energy adoption.
environment.energy: Remove all energy subsidies (fossil and renewable); deregulate energy markets; allow nuclear power expansion with streamlined licensing.
environment.conservation: Privatise public lands for more efficient stewardship; enforce property rights against polluters; oppose eminent domain for conservation.

security.defense: Non-interventionist foreign policy; defend homeland only; withdraw from foreign military bases; end undeclared wars.
security.law_enforcement: End the war on drugs; demilitarise police; eliminate civil asset forfeiture; require warrants for all surveillance; oppose qualified immunity.
security.foreign_policy: Peace through commerce and diplomacy; avoid entangling alliances; withdraw from NATO commitments; end foreign aid.
